newsitem.title: UK: BG Exploration says finds oil in N. Sea well.
newsitem.headline: BG Exploration says finds oil in N. Sea well.

text.p: BG Plc, formerly British Gas Plc, said its exploration and production subsidiary BG Exploration had discovered oil in UK Block 13/24b in North Sea.
The company said the 13/24b-3 discovery well tested sweet 32 degree API oil at a maximum flow rate in excess of 2,600 barrels per day on a 40/64 inch choke.
The discovery lies about 80 miles north-east of Aberdeen.
This was the first well to be drilled by BG Exploration on Block 13/24b, which was awarded in the 14th round of UK licensing in 1993.
"Planning work for an appraisal well to delineate the discovery is in progress," BG said.
BG Exploration controls 50 percent interest in Block 13/24b and operates the block in partnership with Amerada Hess Ltd which controls 30 percent and Rigel Petroleum which holds 20 percent interest.
